# MCP tools

The tools Notoir's [MCP server](../mcp.md) offers to AI clients. Each call is checked against the client's permissions for the listed capabilities; *read-only* tools never change anything, and *destructive* tools always ask for approval unless the client is allowed to skip it.

## `workspace_get`

Describe the open workspace: root path, name, whether it is a Git repository, and how many documents are open in Notoir.

- Capabilities: `workspace.read`
- read-only

No parameters.

## `workspace_list_files`

List workspace files (paged, optional glob). Respects .gitignore and files.exclude unless include_ignored is set.

- Capabilities: `workspace.read`
- read-only

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cursor` | integer | no | Index to continue from (next_cursor of the previous page). |
| `glob` | string | no | Only paths matching this glob (e.g. "docs/**/*.md"). |
| `include_ignored` | boolean | no | Also list files excluded by .gitignore / files.exclude (default false). |
| `limit` | integer | no | Page size (default 500). |

## `workspace_search`

Search text or a regex across the workspace. Open documents are searched as Notoir holds them (unsaved edits included). Paged results with line and column.

- Capabilities: `workspace.search`
- read-only

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `case_sensitive` | boolean | no |  |
| `cursor` | integer | no |  |
| `exclude` | array | no | Globs of files to skip. |
| `include` | array | no | Globs of files to search. |
| `limit` | integer | no | Matches per page (default 200). |
| `query` | string | yes |  |
| `regex` | boolean | no |  |
| `whole_word` | boolean | no |  |

## `document_open`

Load a document into Notoir's memory (no tab unless show is true). Returns its metadata and revision.

- Capabilities: `document.read`
- read-only

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes | Path relative to the workspace root (or absolute inside it). |
| `show` | boolean | no | Also open it in an editor tab (needs editor control). |

## `document_read`

Read a document as Notoir holds it in memory: for an open file with unsaved edits this is the edited buffer, not the disk content (use filesystem_read for disk). Returns content (optionally a line range) with dirty, revision, language, encoding and eol.

- Capabilities: `document.read`
- read-only

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `end_line` | integer | no | Last line to return (inclusive). |
| `path` | string | yes | Path relative to the workspace root (or absolute inside it). |
| `start_line` | integer | no | First line to return (1-based). |

## `document_create`

Create a new file (written to disk immediately) or a Scratchpad, and open it in Notoir.

- Capabilities: `document.create`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `content` | string | no | Initial content (default empty). |
| `path` | string | no | New file to create (must not exist). Omit with scratchpad: true. |
| `scratchpad` | boolean | no | Create a Scratchpad instead of a file. |

## `document_write`

Replace the whole buffer of a document in Notoir's memory. The change is undoable, marks the document dirty and is NOT saved: call document_save to write it.

- Capabilities: `document.modify`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `content` | string | yes | The complete new content of the buffer. |
| `expected_revision` | integer | no | Fail with revision_conflict if the document changed since this revision. |
| `path` | string | yes | Path relative to the workspace root (or absolute inside it). |

## `document_apply_edits`

Apply range edits to a document in Notoir's memory atomically (one undoable step). Not saved until document_save.

- Capabilities: `document.modify`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `edits` | array | yes | Non-overlapping replacements, in coordinates of the current revision; applied as one undoable step. |
| `expected_revision` | integer | no |  |
| `path` | string | yes | Path relative to the workspace root (or absolute inside it). |

## `document_save`

Save an open document to disk through Notoir's normal save pipeline (conflict checks included).

- Capabilities: `document.save`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes | Path relative to the workspace root (or absolute inside it). |

## `document_rename`

Rename or move a workspace file; open documents follow it.

- Capabilities: `file.rename`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `new_path` | string | yes | Destination inside the workspace (must not exist). |
| `path` | string | yes | Path relative to the workspace root (or absolute inside it). |

## `document_delete`

Move a workspace file to the system trash.

- Capabilities: `file.delete`
- destructive

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes | Path relative to the workspace root (or absolute inside it). |

## `editor_get_open_tabs`

List editor groups and their tabs (view id, path or title, dirty, pinned, active).

- Capabilities: `editor.read`
- read-only

No parameters.

## `editor_get_active_document`

The active editor's document (path, view, revision, dirty) and its selections.

- Capabilities: `editor.read`
- read-only

No parameters.

## `editor_get_selection`

The text the user has selected in the active editor (or the given view), with the file and the range of every selection (1-based line/column and 0-based offsets).

- Capabilities: `editor.read`, `document.read`
- read-only

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `view` | integer | no | View id from editor_get_open_tabs (default: the active editor). |

## `editor_open_document`

Open or focus a document in an editor tab, optionally at a line and column. Visible to the user.

- Capabilities: `editor.control`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `column` | integer | no |  |
| `line` | integer | no |  |
| `path` | string | yes | Path relative to the workspace root (or absolute inside it). |

## `editor_select_range`

Set the selection in the active editor (or the document's editor). Visible to the user.

- Capabilities: `editor.control`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `end` | object | yes | A position: {line, column} (1-based, column in characters) or {offset} (0-based character offset). |
| `path` | string | no | Document to select in (default: the active editor). |
| `start` | object | yes | A position: {line, column} (1-based, column in characters) or {offset} (0-based character offset). |

## `editor_insert`

Insert text at every cursor of the active editor (selected text is kept). Undoable; not saved.

- Capabilities: `document.modify`, `editor.read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | string | yes |  |

## `editor_replace`

Replace the current selection(s) of the active editor with text. Undoable; not saved.

- Capabilities: `document.modify`, `editor.read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | string | yes |  |

## `settings_get`

Effective Notoir settings (machine paths are left out).

- Capabilities: `settings.read`
- read-only

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prefix` | string | no | Only keys starting with this (e.g. "editor."). |

## `settings_update`

Change a User or Workspace setting. Restricted settings can never be changed by MCP.

- Capabilities: `settings.modify`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | string | yes |  |
| `scope` | string | no | Default user. One of `"user"`, `"workspace"`. |
| `value` | any | yes | New value (boolean, number, string or string list); null resets it. |

## `git_status`

Git state of the workspace: branch, upstream, ahead/behind, staged changes, changes and conflicts.

- Capabilities: `git.read`
- read-only

No parameters.

## `git_diff`

Unified diff of the work tree (disk) against the index or HEAD, for one file or every changed file.

- Capabilities: `git.read`
- read-only

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `base` | string | no | Compare the work tree with the index (default) or HEAD. One of `"index"`, `"head"`. |
| `path` | string | no | One file (default: every changed file). |

## `filesystem_read`

Read a file from disk directly, ignoring Notoir's unsaved buffers (use document_read for those).

- Capabilities: `filesystem.read`
- read-only

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `end_line` | integer | no | Last line to return (inclusive). |
| `path` | string | yes | Path relative to the workspace root (or absolute inside it). |
| `start_line` | integer | no | First line to return (1-based). |

## `filesystem_write`

Write a file on disk directly (atomic write). Open documents are not changed: Notoir treats it as an external change.

- Capabilities: `filesystem.write`
- destructive

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `content` | string | yes |  |
| `create` | boolean | no | Allow creating a new file (default true). |
| `path` | string | yes | Path relative to the workspace root (or absolute inside it). |
